children: Overview
US drilling services firm's Q3 revenue up 9% sequentially, beating analyst expectations
Net income attributable to common stockholders was $28 mln for the quarter
Company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share
Outlook
Company expects to operate an average of 104 rigs in the US in Q4
Company sees Q4 Drilling Services adjusted gross profit of $150 mln
Company expects Q4 Completion Services adjusted gross profit of $140 mln
Result Drivers
STRONG US DRILLING DEMAND - Co said increased US onshore drilling and completion demand supported higher pricing and returns
UPGRADED RIGS - Co said demand was particularly strong for rigs returning to service following structural upgrades, supporting premium pricing for highest specification rigs
NATURAL GAS ASSETS - Co said completion services results improved as demand was robust for equipment capable of using natural gas as fuel, with positive pricing momentum
